decisions.reason: As a web-map add-on built on the core offer and launched with visible releases, it still benefits from sunk development effort and public commitment, so management is inclined to continue it unless failure becomes unmistakable.

Although a narrower mobile component that could be superseded over time, it was publicly highlighted and fits the firm’s geospatial usability direction, which supports continued backing rather than withdrawal.
Because this platform line was presented as a flagship and closely matches the firm’s stated strategic path, escalation of commitment makes dropping it within a year very unlikely.

This field data capture software remains close to the established portfolio and reflects dedicated investment in a relevant adjacent use case, so management is likely to justify keeping it absent clear negative evidence.
